I now have all the information needed. Here's the complete picture:

**AuthController** (`application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/controller/AuthController.java`) directly declares these service interfaces as fields, plus inherits `userService` from `BaseController`.

| Service Interface | Kind | Concrete Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| `MailService` | Interface | `DefaultMailService` |
| `SystemSecurityService` | Interface | `DefaultSystemSecurityService` |
| `SecuritySettingsService` | Interface | `DefaultSecuritySettingsService` |
| `RateLimitService` | Interface | `DefaultRateLimitService` |
| `TwoFactorAuthService` | Interface | `DefaultTwoFactorAuthService` |
| `UserService` (via `BaseController`) | Interface | `UserServiceImpl` |
| `JwtTokenFactory` | Concrete class | — (no interface) |
| `RestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandler` | Concrete class | — (no interface) |

---

application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/controller/BaseController.java | Parent class providing injected UserService userService field

dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/settings/DefaultSecuritySettingsService.java | Concrete implementation of SecuritySettingsService

application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/auth/mfa/TwoFactorAuthService.java | Service interface TwoFactorAuthService, directly injected into AuthController
